scientific_integrity: The logarithmic coefficient and small-coupling one-bound-state classification are proved by explicit capacity, Birman–Schwinger, and codimension-one estimates; numerical testing is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed nonnegative finitely supported potentials; no multiplicative eigenvalue prefactor or moving-support uniformity.
Prior criticality and the optimal Hardy ground-state identity are credited, not claimed as new.
A general weak-coupling theorem could implicitly subsume this model; historical priority has not been independently certified.
title: Exponentially weak binding at the optimal discrete Hardy boundary
